strings.Wie veel met open source werkt, verzamel: Anyone who works a lot with open source collects hundreds of repositories: in browser tabs, stars, notes and loose folders. Knowledge gets lost there. Why did you save something? Does it still work? What is it connected to?
strings.Plak een repo-URL en hij wordt opgeslage: Paste a repo URL and it's saved with README, stars, forks, language and licence. Search, filter by category and status, and an A–Z index for large collections.
strings.Plak een GitHub-account, een lijst tooln: Paste a GitHub account, a list of tool names or a page URL (blog, Medium, linktree). Harvest fetches the page, pulls out all the GitHub links and lets you choose what goes into the notebook. Nothing is saved until you tick it.
strings.Categorieën, samenvattingen en suggestie: Categories, summaries and suggestions come from a locally running language model. No data to the cloud, no API costs, works offline too.
strings.Per repo een eigen notitie (‘waarom sloe: A note per repo (‘why did you save this?’) and a status: to try, installed, liked, archived. That keeps the collection alive instead of a graveyard.
strings.Repositories als verbonden kaart bekijke: View repositories as a connected map, and clone or open them on GitHub in one click.
